title: Initiation, Human and Solar
author: Alice A. Bailey
description: Initiation, Human and Solar by Alice A. Bailey (New York: Lucifer Publishing Company, 1922), her first book, which she said was dictated telepathically by the Tibetan Master Djwhal Khul. It sets out the structure and functioning of the spiritual Hierarchy of Masters said to guide human and planetary evolution: Sanat Kumara the Lord of the World at Shamballa, the Buddhas of Activity, the three great departments under the Manu, the Bodhisattva (Christ) and the Mahachohan, and the Masters of Wisdom and their ashrams. It describes the path of discipleship and the five major initiations, the role of the Hierophant, the rod of initiation, the oath, the Word, the secrets revealed at each stage, and the solar and cosmic dimensions of initiation. Drawing on and reworking Theosophy, it was foundational for Bailey's Arcane School and much of the later New Age movement, including the idea of the 'Great Invocation'.
